title: Tags and reactions
sub: A tag on an effect, a trigger for an effect that appeared with a tag, and tags to except on a roll.
start: the effects “Wet”, “Burning”, “Luck”, “Cold”, “Frost” and “Warm up” are set up, still empty: no tags and no triggers.

link.title: Tag and reaction
link.sum: “Wet” carries the tag “douses fire”, and “Burning” removes itself when an effect with that tag lands on the sheet.

dice.title: Dice
dice.sum: “Luck” adds to a roll, except rolls with the tag “defense”. No errors.

alone.title: On your own
alone.sum: You built the removal of all effects by a tag without hints.

tag.lead: A tag is a word on an effect. Other effects recognize their own by it: “Burning” should go out when “Wet” lands on the sheet. For that “Wet” needs a tag.
tag.props: If the properties are not visible, press “properties” next to the effect name.
tag.field: In the “Tags” field click “+ tag…” and choose “new tag…”.

when.say: Subscribe “Burning” to the appearance of an effect with the tag “douses fire”.
when.what: In “What happened” choose “effect appeared on the sheet”.
when.which: In “Which” choose the entry with the tag “douses fire”.
when.hint: There is no entry with the tag “douses fire” in “Which” until some effect carries that tag — go back to the previous step.
when.result: “Burning” hears an effect with the tag “douses fire” appear.

who.say: In “Whom it concerns” choose “the sheet it happened to” — the holder: so that “Burning” goes out only on the sheet “Wet” landed on.
who.hint: Without this the trigger fires on every sheet in the room where “Burning” hangs.
who.trap: The condition is set, but it has no “holder”. In “Whom it concerns” choose “the sheet it happened to” — the holder.
who.result: The trigger concerns only the holder's sheet.

remove.say: Add a step to the trigger that removes “Burning”.
remove.hint: The trigger's steps are under it, in “does:”. “+ change” → “state” → in “What we do” choose “remove”.
remove.from: In “From whom” choose “the sheet it happened to”.
remove.result: When an effect with the tag “douses fire” lands on a sheet, “Burning” is removed.

seen.lead: The “dice rolled” trigger hears every roll. “Luck” should help everywhere except defense: such rolls are cut off by a tag.
seen.say: Subscribe “Luck” to “dice rolled”, except rolls with the tag “defense”.
seen.except: In “Except” click “+ except tag…” and choose “defense”.

plus.say: Under the trigger press “+ add”: one will be added to a fitting roll.
plus.hint: “+ add” appears only on a “dice rolled” trigger.

problems.say: Press the “No problems” button in the header (if something is found, it says “Problems” and a number). There should be no errors.

clear.lead: The last task comes without hints.
clear.goal: “Cold” and “Frost” share one tag, “Warm up” removes everything with that tag, and “Problems” shows no errors.
clear.say: Let the effect “Warm up” remove “Cold” and “Frost” from the holder at once: give them one tag and remove all effects with that tag.
clear.hint: The tag is in the properties of “Cold” and “Frost”. In “Warm up”: “+ change” → “state” → “remove” → “Remove” → “all effects with a tag”.
clear.result: “Warm up” removes everything that carries the shared tag.
